## Describe the Issue
Is a pattern broken, or has an infrastructure provider modified their free-tier limits or deprecated endpoints?

## Affected Pattern / Section
- Section number or pattern directory (e.g., patterns/ai-cascade/, patterns/neon-sleep/, patterns/cron-webhook/, etc.)

## Provider Update or Error Observed
If a provider changed their policy, please link to the official announcement or documentation.
If an error was observed in code, provide the exact error message and minimal reproduction steps.

## Expected Behavior vs Actual Behavior
What worked previously, and what happens now?
